items.html: And the matter is that the verse says "her food, her clothing, and her conjugal rights he shall not diminish" (she'era kesuta ve-onata lo yigra). And behold, these three are not found together except in Atzilut, in the secret of the conjugal right (Onata) of the new souls; and likewise they exist in Beria, only they are in the secret of the angels, as above. And in Yetzira the secret of the conjugal right is lacking, and in Assiya there is only She'era alone.
